📅 Lab Schedule

This document provides the semester framework. Your specific section times and room numbers are listed in the course syllabus on the LMS.

Semester Overview

Week Dates (Example — confirm on LMS) Topic / Activity Notes
1 Aug 18 – 22 Orientation, safety sign-off, ELN setup Bring printed safety checklist
2 Aug 25 – 29 Introduction to aseptic technique Pre-lab reading required
3 Sep 1 – 5 Bacterial transformation (Day 1) No Labor Day section — check your TA
4 Sep 8 – 12 Bacterial transformation (Day 2) — colony screening  
5 Sep 15 – 19 PCR amplification  
6 Sep 22 – 26 Gel electrophoresis & analysis  
7 Sep 29 – Oct 3 Restriction digest  
8 Oct 6 – 10 Midterm practical / quiz  
9 Oct 13 – 17 Microbial enumeration (dilution plating)  
10 Oct 20 – 24 Gram staining & microscopy  
11 Oct 27 – 31 Unknown organism identification (Day 1)  
12 Nov 3 – 7 Unknown organism identification (Day 2)  
13 Nov 10 – 14 Data analysis & figure preparation  
14 Nov 17 – 21 Lab reports / peer review  
15 Nov 24 – 26 Thanksgiving break — no lab  
16 Dec 1 – 5 Presentations & final practical  

📌 Dates are illustrative. Always defer to the official calendar posted in Moodle/Canvas.

Weekly Lab Structure

Time Block Activity
0:00 – 0:15 Pre-lab discussion / safety reminders
0:15 – 0:30 Review of experimental design & ELN setup
0:30 – 2:00 Hands-on experimental work
2:00 – 2:30 Clean-up, waste disposal, decontamination
2:30 – 3:00 Data recording, post-lab Q&A

Bench Assignments

Bench assignments are posted on the lab door and in the LMS by the end of Week 1. Assignments are permanent for the semester unless a lab-safety concern requires reassignment.
